description: This file provides an API utility function, listOrganizations, for fetching and processing a list of organizations (tenants) associated with the current user. It interacts with a backend API at the endpoint /session/tenants and normalizes the response data into a consistent format.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches the list of organizations (tenants) for the current user from the backend API, normalizes the data structure, sorts the results by name then id, and returns an array of organization objects with id and name.
